item.tib: mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi las tshogs me chu rlung sa bcol dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'i phreng ba spel
item.coloph: ces me chu rlung sa bzhi la 'phrin las bcol ba'i las tshogs dbang bsgyar 'khor lo 'di ni/ shar rong rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing gi byang phyogs/ mkha' 'gro 'du gnas ke'u nyi ma rang shar du/ rigs ldan gyi gzung ma karma spos can gyi grogs ldan mdzad pas/ thugs gsang ba ye shes kyi 'khor lo cig char du phyed de/ kun gzhi gsal stong nam mkha'i dbyings su/ rig pa brda yi thig le skar tshogs nges par bkra ba nas/ shugs 'byung bkag med kyi gu ge ris su/ snyigs dus rnam 'byor chen po kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying pos me 'brug hor zla bdun pa sa gzhi rnams rtsi bcud kyi bum pa bzang po'i 'geng dus su brtsams pa/ 'chi med rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'di phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig
